# Forex School (مکتب فارکس)

> Forex School is a free, bilingual (Dari and English) forex-education community for Afghan
> and Afghan-diaspora traders, founded by Mohammad Akhondzadeh (in the industry since 2012).
> It teaches trading the honest way — education first, with risk management at the centre of
> every lesson — and makes no profit promises. All lessons, tools and content are 100% free
> and delivered through a WhatsApp channel. The site is available in English (root URLs) and
> Farsi/Dari (URLs under /fa/).

## Key facts
- Name: Forex School (Dari: مکتب فارکس). Domain: https://forexschool.store
- Founder & instructor: Mohammad Akhondzadeh (محمد آخوندزاده) — forex since 2012; BBA, pursuing MBA.
- Audience: Afghan and Afghan-diaspora forex learners; primary teaching language Dari, with English.
- Cost: free. Business model: education community, not course sales; no financial advice, no profit promises.
- Curriculum: Beginner course — 13 lessons (00–12); Advanced course — 21 lessons across 6 modules (F, A, AS, B, C, D). Total 34 lessons.
- Free tools: risk calculator; live economic calendar.

## Core pages (English)
- [Home](https://forexschool.store/index.html): overview of the free Dari-and-English forex school.
- [Brokers](https://forexschool.store/brokers.html): a guide for Afghan traders to well-known forex brokers — regulation, minimum deposit, costs, platforms and withdrawals (educational, not a recommendation).
- [Courses](https://forexschool.store/courses.html): the 13-lesson beginner course and 21-lesson (6-module) advanced course. Every lesson has its own page with a short introduction, in English and Dari (/fa/lessons/…); the full lessons are taught in the free online classes:
